name: Almost Heaven Denali 6-Person Indoor Sauna
description: Almost Heaven Denali 6-Person Indoor Sauna Experience the epitome of relaxation with the Almost Heaven Denali 6-Person Indoor Traditional Sauna , available at Select Saunas. Crafted to elevate your well-being, this sauna invites you to immerse yourself in the timeless tradition of sauna bathing from the comfort of your own home. Step into a world of warmth and rejuvenation, where cedar craftsmanship and modern technology harmonize seamlessly. The Denali Indoor Sauna offers a spacious retreat for up to six individuals, perfect for bonding with friends and family. Its cedar lumber not only exudes a delightful aroma but also promises durability for years to come. With its traditional heating system, this sauna provides an authentic experience for detoxification, improved circulation, and profound relaxation. Elevate your wellness journey with the Almost Heaven Denali, available at Select Saunas. Features Tongue-and-groove lumber sections: 1-3/8” finished thickness Pre-assembled wall and roof sections Choose between rustic or clear western red cedar construction Extra height interior for added head space Multi-level benches for height/heat variation Wall-to-wall floor sections built of 1×2” slatted rustic or clear western cedar lumber Tempered glass door with long stainless handle on the outside, wooden on the inside Stainless steel hinges, heater, and fasteners Deluxe stainless steel bucket, ladle, and thermometer/hygrometer kit Backlit therapeutic salt backrest with LED lighting, 110V plug-in 2 full-length benches, multi-level seating 1 lower “L” bench for added seating Vertical slat 2×4” benches built of rustic or clear western cedar timbers Stone accent wall behind the heater to radiate heat Standard 9 kW Virta deluxe sauna heater by Harvia for maximum power and fast heat-up time Digital heater control; can be mounted on the interior or exterior of sauna Hand-crafted construction Indoor usage Easy assembly for 2 people Manufactured in the USA Specifications Holds up to six people Heater size: 9 kW Virta deluxe heater with Xenio WiFi digital control panel; interior or exterior mount Heater electrical: 220V, 40-amp service for heater; 8/3 hardwire connect LED light electrical: 110V plug-in Exterior dimensions: 86”W x 63”D x 84.5”H Interior dimensions: 81”W x 58”D x 80.5”H Lower bench size dimensions: 81”L x 14”W x 22”H Upper bench size dimensions: 81”L x 22”W x 36”H Lower bench “L” extension dimensions” 24”L x 26”W x 22”H Door size: 64”H x 24”W Window size: 64”H x 17”H (2) Shipping dimensions: 74”L x 40”W x 49”H Shipping weight: 950 lbs Assembled weight: 825 lbs Assembly Some basic handyman skills are helpful when assembling the sauna. The only additional equipment needed is a cordless drill. Two people can generally do the assembly in 6 hours or less. It is recommended that you review the assembly manual in advance to familiarize yourself with the process. Resources Denali Installation & Owner's Manual Videos
